files.bytes:
Harbor Tools — Company update — September 20, 2026
To: Arun
We reported 18 customers in our current customer list. The team is reviewing onboarding and preparing a founder discussion. We have not supplied customer-level usage, revenue, contract values, or a customer concentration breakdown in this update. Please bring questions about concentration to our next meeting.
Nila, founder

Harbor Tools — Correction — October 3, 2026
To: Arun
Our September 20 customer count of 18 was incorrect. The corrected count is 12 customers. Use 12 as the current count; the September 20 figure is superseded. This correction does not provide revenue, growth, customer-level contract values, or customer concentration. At the founder meeting we can discuss how to understand customer concentration.
Nila, founder
